advice.patches_part: Try part your hair for another place. Hair dey fall different from a new line, and few tries go show you which one you like.
advice.patches_brow: Soft eyebrow colour dey make your face look complete. Try di previews wey dey below.
advice.patches_volume: Volume preview dey show fuller look for your next photo. E be preview, no be promise.
advice.patches_own_report: Di hair density reading no clear dis time, so dis stage come from wetin you tell us.
advice.fullness_neckline: Try neckline wey open for di collar, like V or wide scoop, and compare am with normal round neck.
advice.fullness_collar: Collar and fitted shirt fit wait until your size settle. Soft collar dey okay for now.
advice.fullness_frame: If you dey wear glasses, try few frames wey wide like your face, and pick di one wey feel like you.
advice.surgery_soft: Start with soft cloth, loose cuts and seams wey dey far from anywhere wey dey sensitive.
advice.surgery_front_opening: Cloth wey open for front dey easy to wear and to comot.
advice.surgery_relaxed_first: Loose cloth dey work well today. Fitted ones fit wait until your shape settle.
advice.surgery_settled: Your shape don settle, so e good make you buy fitted cloth for di size wey you tell us.
advice.surgery_photos_off: Body photos dey off, so we no dey show cloth for your body. You fit turn dem on for settings anytime you want.
advice.skin_match_clothes: Dis cloth colours go well with your skin colour reading. Hold dem near your face to compare.
advice.skin_match_makeup: Makeup shades wey near dese ones go suit di same reading. Compare dem for daylight.
advice.skin_match_recheck: Your colour still dey change, so check di shades again for every check in before you buy plenty.
advice.skin_match_unmeasured: Skin colour reading never clear yet, so we no get colours to suggest. Take front photo for even daylight for your next check in.

privacy.title: Your privacy for Interim
privacy.intro: Interim dey use your information to keep your account, compare check ins and make your cards.

data.title: Wetin we keep
data.body: We still keep your email, sign-in details, choices and consent record. We store password as hash, no be the password itself. Reflection wey you save dey encrypted.

processors.title: Who dey use am
processors.body: Cloudflare R2 dey store photos and previews. Brevo dey send account emails. If you choose Google sign-in, na Google dey handle that sign-in. Your choices fit show private information, so share only wetin you comfortable to share.

retention.title: How long we keep am
retention.body: New check in dey start the history period again. Your answers and card text go stay until you delete the profile. Account details go stay until you delete your account.

choices.title: Wetin you fit choose
choices.body: From your profile you fit download your data, change how long photos go stay or delete the profile. You fit delete account for account settings. Share links dey show previews and some card text, never original photos or reflections. You fit stop a link. Unit records wey no get personal content go remain after you delete.

cookies.title: Cookies and notifications
cookies.body: Cookies dey keep you signed in and remember your language and theme. Notifications dey off until you choose am. You fit turn am off for settings.

privacy.contact: For questions about your data, contact Interim:

serviceTerms.title: Rules to use Interim
serviceTerms.intro: Interim dey give practical ideas for your appearance and clothes. These rules explain how to use am.

adults.title: Na adults only
adults.body: Use Interim only if you don reach {age} years. Read the privacy information and consent choices before you add photos.

photos.title: Your own photos
photos.body: Upload only photos of yourself wey you get permission to use. No put other people inside the photo. You allow Interim and the processors wey consent screen name to use am for the features wey you request.

previews.title: Previews and suggestions
previews.body: Preview no promise result or how cloth go fit. Sizes dey use wetin you tell us and the catalog size charts. Check details before you buy. For health questions, talk to doctor or nurse.

account.title: Your account and sharing
account.body: Keep your sign-in details private. Anybody wey get share link fit see wetin dey inside until e expire or you stop am. You fit download or delete your profile and delete your account.

availability.title: When service dey available
availability.body: Interim na prototype. Features fit change or no dey available, and results fit wrong. Demo people na simulated people. Interim no dey place orders or collect payments.
